parent_objective: design temporal command-response mismatch interventions after current-model coverage refresh remains reset-only

public_gates: design uses M716 reset-only rows and M713 low-alpha rows without source export or training
interventions distinguish reset hidden wrong cross-fault hidden delayed hidden stale pre-fault hidden and action-response mismatch
acceptance criteria require action and margin changes beyond reset-only overclaiming
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden fault labels or oracle values to actor inputs
do not treat reset-only rows as wrong-history proof
do not claim temporal mismatch evidence before implementation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_temporal_history: design delayed stale and action-response-mismatch history interventions
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a no-training intervention design that directly attacks command-response temporal consistency after M716 current-model coverage remains reset-only
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new behavior claim and no checkpoint promotion
stop_condition: stop if temporal interventions collapse to reset-only diagnostics without wrong or stale history specificity
stop if required histories cannot be reconstructed from current artifacts
stop actor mutation until exact no-training gates show action or outcome sensitivity
fallback_plan: if delayed/stale histories are source-positive, implement a source-balanced temporal intervention gate
if temporal interventions are neutral, return to M713 actor-head residual objective design
if temporal intervention requires richer dynamics, design explicit yaw-disturbance or four-wheel model support
if only reset rows are positive, keep them as diagnostics and do not export source-positive corpus

hypothesis: Cross-fault hidden swaps may be too weak because they break identity but not temporal consistency; delayed, stale, and action-response-mismatched histories should more directly test whether the actor uses its own command-response sequence.
success_criteria: M718 defines intervention variants and source rows
M718 defines exact action and margin gates
M718 names implementation artifacts for M719
no training PPO actor update or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: design admits actor update PPO or promotion
design depends on fault labels as actor inputs
decision_rule: M718 may admit only a no-training M719 implementation. It must not admit actor update, PPO, or promotion.
